layout.footer: You receive this message because you are a stakeholder of {application_name}. Manage your subscriptions with the application team in Keigan.
layout.automated: This message was generated automatically by Keigan. Please verify critical facts with the incident record.

incident_detected.subject: [{priority}] Incident detected: {title}
incident_detected.headline: Incident detected
incident_detected.intro: Keigan detected a new incident in {application_name} and has started investigating.

preliminary_report.subject: [{priority}] Preliminary report: {title}
preliminary_report.headline: Preliminary investigation report
preliminary_report.intro: Keigan finished its first investigation of this incident. The findings are preliminary and may change.

progress_update.subject: [{priority}] Update: {title}
progress_update.headline: Incident update
progress_update.intro: An update on the incident in {application_name}.

resolution_update.subject: [{priority}] Resolved: {title}
resolution_update.headline: Incident resolved
resolution_update.intro: The incident in {application_name} has been resolved.

executive_summary.subject: [{priority}] Executive summary: {title}
executive_summary.headline: Executive summary
executive_summary.intro: A short summary for leadership about the incident in {application_name}.

postmortem.subject: Postmortem: {title}
postmortem.headline: Postmortem report
postmortem.intro: The postmortem for the incident in {application_name} is ready.

slo_burn_alert.subject: [{severity}] SLO burn alert: {title}
slo_burn_alert.headline: SLO error budget is burning fast
slo_burn_alert.intro: The error budget of an SLO in {application_name} is being consumed faster than planned.

test.subject: Keigan test notification for {application_name}
test.headline: Test notification
test.intro: This is a test message so you can confirm that Keigan notifications reach you.

team_invitation.subject: You were added to {application_name} in Keigan
team_invitation.headline: You are on the team
team_invitation.intro: You were added to the team of {application_name} in Keigan, which gathers evidence and explains incidents for the application.
team_invitation.access_note: To open the application you need access through the group {reader_group}. If you cannot open it, request that group (or {admin_group} to change settings) in SailPoint. Keigan does not grant access itself.

chat.welcome: I am Keigan. I will post investigation findings here and learn from your discussion. Ask me with "Keigan, ...". Say "Keigan, this is finished" when the incident is done and I will prepare the postmortem.
chat.milestone_ack: Understood. I am generating the postmortem draft now; it will appear in Keigan shortly.
chat.no_answer: I could not answer that right now. Open the investigation in Keigan for the full findings.
